Script.name: searchwin
Script.script:
--[[ Search window Sean Stoves, 2026-08-02
'search all' / 'eqsearch all' copied into a panel of its own, paged, fresh every time you run one. The report still scrolls past in the main window - this is an extra copy that stays put and doesn't scroll away.
Unlike help there is no tag for this - Aardwolf's telnet channel 102 has options for helpfiles, the map, channels and a dozen other things, and none for search. So it's read off the output, and the output is fixed-width and self-announcing:
Finding best searchable items for all equipment slots:
Item Current New Wear Loc New Item Level Location Points Points -------- ----------------------------------- ----- ---------- ------- ------ Light Bioluminescence of Iviruan Fireflie 171 Seekers 220 315 ... Wielded Topaz Shard 161 Touchstone 1693 1758
Note: * Searchable item list is only a small portion of game items. * Enchantments can greatly improve the power of all equipment. * Quest Items are almost always the best for your level.
The panel holds the table and nothing else. The opening line is an announcement - you know what you ran - and the Note block underneath is the MUD's standing advice about searchable items, the same three lines every time. Both are skipped, along with the blank runs; the table has no blank rows inside it, so dropping every blank leaves exactly the header, the rule and the rows.
The Note block also ends the capture. The prompt is the backstop behind it, because Note is wording the MUD can change while hp/mn/mv in brackets is structural.
Nothing is gagged. This is a copy, not a move: the report scrolls past in the main window exactly as it always did, and the panel is a second, readable copy of it that stays put. copy() and appendBuffer take a line's formatting without taking the line.
Paged rather than scrolled, for the reason in the panel manager: a scrolled Mudlet console splits into two panes with a divider across it, which is right for the MUD window and wrong for a document. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.searchwin = aardkit.searchwin or {}
local SW = aardkit.searchwin local U = aardkit.util.named("Search")
local CFG = U.load("searchwin", { on = true, gag = false, -- a copy by default; the report still scrolls past })
-- declared ahead of the closures below so they bind this local rather than a -- global of the same name, which is nil forever local panel
panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "search", title = "Search", width = 720, height = 420, x = "150px", y = "90px", fontSize = 10, -- put up by running a search and by nothing else transient = true, onresize = function() if aardkit.searchwin.panel then aardkit.searchwin.panel:page_paint() end end, onbuild = function() if aardkit.searchwin.panel then aardkit.searchwin.panel.pagebtn = {} end end, })
SW.panel = panel
--- -- capture ---
local capturing, trig, timer
local function stop() if trig then pcall(killTrigger, trig); trig = nil end if timer then pcall(killTimer, timer); timer = nil end capturing = false end
-- The Aardwolf prompt, which is what actually ends the block. Matching on the -- Note lines instead would tie us to the MUD's wording; hp/mn/mv in brackets is -- structural and has been on every prompt for as long as the game has existed. local function is_prompt(line) return line:match("%d+/%d+hp") and line:match("%d+/%d+mn") and true or false end
function SW.on_start() if not CFG.on then return end stop() panel:page_begin() -- The "Finding best searchable items..." line is an announcement, not the -- report - you know what you ran. It's the trigger, not content. if CFG.gag then U.gag() end panel:show() capturing = true
trig = tempRegexTrigger([[^.*$]], function() local line = getCurrentLine() or "" -- the prompt is not ours to take; stop in front of it if is_prompt(line) then stop() panel:page_end() return end -- The Note block is the MUD's standing advice about searchable items - -- the same three lines every single run - and it ends the table. if line:match("^%s*Note:") then stop() panel:page_end() return end -- The table has no blank rows inside it, so dropping every blank leaves -- the header, the rule and the rows and nothing else. It also saves -- having to hold a blank back to see whether anything follows it. if line:match("^%s*$") then if CFG.gag then U.gag() end return end panel:page_add() if CFG.gag then U.gag() end end)
-- a search that never reaches a prompt would eat the rest of the session timer = tempTimer(15, function() if capturing then stop() panel:page_end() U.warn("Search: no prompt arrived - stopped capturing.") end end) end
--- -- commands ---
function SW.cmd(arg) local verb = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "toggle" then panel:toggle()
elseif verb == "on" or verb == "off" then CFG.on = (verb == "on") U.save("searchwin", CFG) if not CFG.on then stop() end U.ok("Search window " .. verb .. (CFG.on and " - 'search all' is copied to the panel." or " - main window only."))
elseif verb == "gag" then CFG.gag = not CFG.gag U.save("searchwin", CFG) U.ok("Search: " .. (CFG.gag and "panel only - the report is hidden from the main window." or "in both places."))
elseif verb == "next" then aardkit.panel.page_next("search") elseif verb == "prev" then aardkit.panel.page_prev("search")
elseif verb == "clear" then panel:page_begin() panel:page_paint() U.ok("Search window cleared.")
elseif verb == "dock" or verb == "embed" or verb == "show" or verb == "hide" then aardkit.panel.cmd("search " .. verb)
else U.help("Search window", { { "searchwin toggle", "show or hide the panel" }, { "state", CFG.on and "on" or "off" }, { "main window", CFG.gag and "hidden - panel only" or "still prints there too" }, { "showing", (panel.total or 0) > 0 and (panel.total .. " lines, page " .. (panel.page or 1) .. " of " .. (panel.pages or 1)) or "nothing yet" }, { "" }, { "searchwin", "show or hide the panel" }, { "searchwin on | off", "copy it to the panel, or main window only" }, { "searchwin gag", "hide it from the main window, or show it in both" }, { "searchwin next | prev", "page through it, same as the buttons" }, { "searchwin clear", "empty it" }, { "searchwin dock | embed | show | hide", "panel placement" }, { "" }, { "Run 'search all' or 'eqsearch all' as you always have. The" }, { "report still scrolls past in the main window; this is a copy." }, }) end end
aardkit.register("searchwin", "'search all' in its own panel, fresh each run", SW.cmd)
